text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since I became a
trainer at Tracen Academy, but I
still have
no trainee—heck, I haven't even
attempted to scout anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not for a lack of talent, of course. Every
student here is packed with potential. But
whenever I think about scouting a runner,
something
always holds me back...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then, if I may offer some advice... perhaps what you need to do is think outside the box?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! ♪ As I'm sure you know, the
Twinkle Series isn't the only
race series
Umamusume run in!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Each region of Japan also holds its own
independent series, and the
racers there
compete just as fiercely as those in
national races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In the past, we've had trainers find real
talented racers in the regionals. We've
simply transferred them to Tracen
Academy so they
could sign a contract.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as there's a race today in Oi, I
decide to head over to see
what their
racers are made of. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The confusion that comes with navigating
a new area is one thing, but
on top of
that...

text_block_list.name: Fiesty Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: MRRRAOW!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I encounter an absolute beast of a cat, who apparently decided I'd make the perfect prey! After a long, long game of cat and mouse...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle...

Bwahahahaha! Whoa-ho there, you good?
Ya look like you're bouta
keel over!

text_block_list.name: Fiesty Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Mrrraow...

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well,
if it isn't our resident furball...
What's that? This stranger
was trespassin'
on your turf?

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aw c'mon, lay off, will ya? This stranger
didn't know any better. How
about ya let
'em go, huh? Good kitty, kitty, kitty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume fearlessly reaches out
and pets the hissing menace.
In an instant,
the ferocious feline transforms into a
tame housecat!
This is... the work of a master cat
whisperer!

text_block_list.name: Fiesty Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meeeeeow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All right, catch ya later!
So... guessin' this
is your first time here?
Locals don't usually get
bullied by the cats or wander 'round
like lost, hungry kids.

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Lucky for you, you ran into me! Lemme
show ya to the tastiest soba
place in town!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So what? Leavin' people in need high and
dry's not my style. Now
c'mon, let's get
you some noodles!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, the fearless Umamusume leads
me to the local shopping district. She
walks with such confidence, I almost think
she owns the
place!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well,
if it isn't li'l Inari! How
would ya like some fried tofu?
I've got
plenty to go around!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, might needa take ya up on that! But
before that, I brought ya a
customer! Can
ya get 'em some soba?

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome! Hehe, since Inari brought
you, I better treat you right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, the soba I order comes topped with not one, but two shrimp tempura—a welcome surprise for my empty stomach!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That soba really slaps,
right? This joint's
the best in town!
...By the way, whatcha
doing in our neck of the woods, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If it's a guide ya need, I'm your Uma! I
know these streets like the
back of my
hand. So let's hear it—where ya headed?

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did you just say... Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Talk about good timin'! That's where I'm
headed after this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With my trusty guide's help,
I successfully
make it to Oi Racecourse. It
looks like I'm
just in time to see the local tryout
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text: HRRRAUGH! GET OUTTA MY WAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who would've guessed I'd see her in the
tryouts today! But more
importantly!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At long last,
the final straight! Kicking into
high gear and leaving a cloud of dust in
her wake is none other than Inari One!
Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Time to pull out... THE FINISHER!
Urrraaaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Inari One!
Inari One takes the lead by two,
no, three lengths and
growing! She's got
this! Inari One...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Crosses the finish line! Inari One has won
her tryout race by four
whole lengths! That
little body of hers really packs a
punch! A flawless victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I suddenly gasp for air,
I realize... I was
so enthralled by her race
that I forgot to
breathe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A heart-pounding performance, a run
powerful enough to shake the very earth...
that competitive spirit that blazes like
the festival
fireworks, and the speed to leave
even the sand glistening...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can tell from that race alone that she's
got what it takes for turf
races—for the
Twinkle Series! She's the one! I... I...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sorry,
but no. I appreciate the offer,
but I can't take ya up on
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, I rushed over to Inari One
to give her my pitch. While she was kind
enough to hear me out, her answer comes
quickly and
firmly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You can probably tell by now, but I was
born and raised in this town! The people
here are like family—they've been watchin'
over me since
I was a teeterin' tot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And that includes my racin'. My trainer—Chief practically raised me, and I wanna make it big on his team.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, well...

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I finally found you,
Inari! Congrats on
the win! I, uh... I ended up
in fifth, so I
guess my stamina still needs some work...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, lighten up! All that hard work
gotcha onto the scoreboard, didn't it?
Besides, pretty sure the old man has
already scouted ya,
right?

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text: Yeah! And now I'm gonna be on the same team as the Inari One! I couldn't be happier! I can't wait to train with you!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I'm interrupting your
conversation,
aren't I? I'll let you get
back to it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Okay, catch ya later!
...I think that convo
explains things better than I could.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Edo girl through and through. I
don't wanna leave my teacher
and all my
teammates behind... Sorry 'bout that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Aw, c'mon, ya look like a deflated balloon. Cheer up, ya clearly got an eye for talent!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You'll find a trainee at Tracen in no
time. I
mean, that place is famous
for its crazy
talented students, ri—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But... what?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, well... I-is that so? Uhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You... know the way back, right? Try not
to get cornered by the
furball this time.

Anyway, uh... thanks for comin'!
